title: λ Andromedae, CHARA/MIRC, six nights from 2 to 24 September 2011 (Parks et al. 2021; Martinez et al. 2021)
band: infrared H band (1.49-1.73 um, eight channels)

papers.title: Martinez et al. (2021): Dynamical Surface Imaging of λ Andromedae
papers.locator: arXiv listing and Crossref: title, authors, DOI. Table 4 gives the star's angular radius, limb-darkening coefficient, inclination, position angle and rotation period; section V describes the ROTIR reconstruction of the 2010 and 2011 nights.

papers.title: Parks et al. (2021): Interferometric Imaging of λ Andromedae: Evidence of Starspots and Rotation
papers.locator: arXiv listing and Crossref: title, authors, DOI. Table 1 lists the six nights of September 2011 and their numbers of points; section III.2 describes the SQUEEZE images.

data.title: λ Andromedae, CHARA/MIRC calibrated visibilities of six nights of September 2011, as shipped with ROTIR.jl
data.license: Shipped in the public ROTIR.jl repository (GPL-3.0); CHARA Array data, acknowledge the array and the papers
data.locator: Six files 2011Sep02 to 2011Sep24 .lam_And_prepped.oifits under demos/data at the pinned commit, read by demos/lam_and_reconstruction.jl there; their numbers of squared visibilities match Parks et al. (2021), Table 1.
data.credit: CHARA Array/MIRC, September 2011, as calibrated by the authors of Parks et al. (2021) and Martinez et al. (2021) and shipped with ROTIR.jl (F. Baron)

filesSource: The calibrated files the authors ship with ROTIR.jl at the commit this repository pins (demos/data), the six nights of 2011 both papers image.

diameterMas.source: Martinez et al. (2021), ApJ 916, 60, Table 4 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.06366): angular radius 1.371 +/- 0.005 mas

limbPowerLaw.source: Martinez et al. (2021), ApJ 916, 60, Table 4 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.06366): limb-darkening coefficient 0.231 +/- 0.024, power law

inclinationDegrees.source: Martinez et al. (2021), ApJ 916, 60, Table 4 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.06366): inclination 85.63 +/- 2.32 degrees

positionAngleDegrees.source: Martinez et al. (2021), ApJ 916, 60, Table 4 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.06366): position angle 26.09 +/- 0.82 degrees

rotationPeriodDays.source: Martinez et al. (2021), ApJ 916, 60, Table 4 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.06366): rotation period 54.2 d, held fixed in the fit

reconstruction.source: demos/lam_and_reconstruction.jl in ROTIR.jl at the pinned commit, the authors script for these six files: HEALPix level 3, sobel2 at weight 10, 1000 iterations. The paper printed a total-variation weight of 0.01 for its 2021 code; the pinned code states that its regularizer weights do not carry over.

referenceNightSource: A display choice of this repository: the night with the most squared visibilities (864).
